name: Global Preconditioner for Encoder-Induced Metric
definition: A linear transformation A* applied to the input space to isotropize the average encoder-induced metric, ensuring all directions are treated equally and avoiding global rescaling via volume preservation.
summary: The Global Preconditioner for Encoder-Induced Metric is a fixed, volume-preserving linear transformation that isotropizes the average metric of HashGrid encodings, reducing directional bias without globally rescaling the volume.
